ElevenLabs

Voice production with clear editorial control.

EOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Generate speech from approved scripts through ElevenLabs' supported audio APIs. MoreSpace can build narration queues, multilingual content-production tools, and audio review workspaces that keep scripts, voice choices, pronunciation notes, and exported versions together. Voice output is reviewed for intelligibility, timing, identity permissions, and brand tone before being combined with a finished video or communication asset.

Useful outputs

  • Candidate narration audio
  • Versioned script and voice metadata
  • Approved audio exports for editing

Where we can apply it

  • Approved video script → narration candidates → editor review → final soundtrack.
  • Product facts → multilingual script review → speech production → regional campaign assets.
  • Training content → audio queue → pronunciation correction → learning-library export.

Inputs we need

  • Approved script and language
  • Permitted voice selection
  • Pronunciation and timing notes

Delivery sequence

  • Agree on the voice, language, and rights to the requested identity.
  • Generate audio from the reviewed script and retain production settings.
  • Check pronunciation and pacing, then export only approved takes.

Expert review points

  • Verify the speaker identity is authorized for the intended use.
  • Check pronunciation, meaning, and timing in each required language.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
